rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Kallana, the reported dwarf forest elephant of Kaani traditions. Native square PNG at least1024x1024.
ANATOMY: ONE DWARF elephant, one head/two eyes, trunk/two elephant ears, FOUR short legs and one tail; NATURAL elephant anatomy, no wings/horns/extra tusks or fantasy additions. Small stature obvious relative to normal forest undergrowth; render a MATURE DWARF individual, not baby. Narrow wary natural eyes and heavily weathered skin. [kallana-c01, kallana-c07]
MOMENT: SCRAMBLE toward low viewer over steep wet BOULDERS, trunk lowered horizontally forward and forefoot planting powerfully beside camera, alert eyes and rocking body, stone grit splashing.
POWER: No documented supernatural power; tension through physical close charge and difficult rocky terrain only. [kallana-c01, kallana-c07]
SCALE & CAMERA: Extreme low close camera beside rock; dwarf elephant face/trunk and planting forefoot dominate; surrounding broad leaves and small boulders show smaller elephant size.
LIGHT & WEATHER: One warm afternoon shaft through dense forest shade, deep walnut shadows over eyes, wet warm rim light and water droplets.
SURFACE: Tangible natural fur, feathers, skin, wet scales, coarse opaque cloth, weathered wood or stone appropriate to anatomy. No plastic finish.
SETTING: Rocky higher-altitude South Indian forest terrain where Kaani communities report smaller elephants. [kallana-c01, kallana-c07]
MOOD: Powerful mythic danger or reverent awe appropriate to source. Benevolent beings remain protective; living religions treated respectfully. Never cute, calm, decorative or static. Substantial action and distinguishing anatomy remain striking at200px.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: No text, letters, glyphs, logo, watermark, border or frame; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design from films/games/anime/comics; no nudity or explicit gore. Fully opaque clothing on clothed humanoids. No generic glow aura, neon outlines, colored energy ribbons, floating runes or unclaimed powers. Bracketed claim IDs are instructions never visible text.
TARGETED CORRECTION: Preserve natural dwarf elephant smallsize and4legs/trunk/ears. EDIT into mature dwarf elephant, NOT baby: no infant roundedforehead or sweetwideeyes. Narrow wary natural eyes under deep brow shadows, mature heavilyweathered skin and substantial body weight; no tusks/fangs. Nearcamera forefoot presses and slides rocky slope with gravel/water splash. Trunk stretched low acrossforeground, not cute upwardwave. Tight lowwaterlevel framing and dramaticafternoon forestshade with one warm rimlight. Physical formidable presence on steep terrain, no invented demonhostility or magic.
